name: Chimerical Reality
body:
School illusion (phantasm)) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 4, mesmerist 3, psychic 4, occultist 4, sorcerer/wizard 5

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a phantasm of a split in the target’s reality where they see a multitude of possible realities. Each round at the beginning of their turn, the creature must make a Will save or be dazed by the overload of information. On a successful saving throw, the target is dazzled. If the target makes 3 consecutive saving throws, the spell ends.
